name: Her Beautiful Dream
source: In a world of everlasting strife, the Princess, next heir to the throne was kidnapped. In the attempt to return to her homeland with a cool-headed mercenary, they come across something... extraordinary. Can she discover the truth of this world; with the powerful magic that she has inherited? This is an epic story of love and determination... that "you" must make.
translation: 在一个永远纷争的世界里，下一任王位继承人公主被绑架了。在试图与一名冷静的雇佣兵一起返回家园的过程中，他们遇到了一些……非同寻常的事情。她能否发现这个世界的真相？凭借她继承的强大魔法？这是一个关于爱和决心的史诗故事……“你”必须完成。
